built: SBGN-ML 0.3 Process Description exporter over a final_mapped-schema payload: sbgn_export(payload, ir=None, title=None) -> (text, report), sbgn_text, write_sbgn. Pure (stdlib ElementTree, no network/DB/LLM). Compartment glyph per subcellular location used ('unspecified' when a state has none), one entity glyph per (entity, compartment): simple chemical / macromolecule / complex (members nested) / nucleic acid feature. Reaction and transport -> process glyph with consumption, production, catalysis (enzymes, transporters, catalyst-role modifiers) and stimulation/inhibition/modulation arcs (modifier roles, interactions). Database ids from mapped_ids go in <extension><t2pw:ids .../>. Positions from the PWML IR (locations, bound_visualizations, process_visualizations) when given, else a deterministic grid; entities missing from the IR fall back to the grid.

export_97.process_glyphs_equal_reactions_plus_tran: 97 of 97 files (498 process glyphs = 424 reactions + 74 transports)

proofs.validators: lxml XMLSchema on SBGN.xsd; lxml isoschematron on sbgn_pd.sch phase 'basic' after in-memory edits (see SOURCE.txt); pd10133 and the sanity phase cannot run in XSLT 1.0 (pd10133 re-checked in Python). Negative control: dropping a compartmentRef fails pd10112.

dead_ends: Brief says runlist.json[idx]; the IR index is into the q=true subset of runlist.json (152 entries), not the raw 192-entry list. Using the raw list pairs an IR with the wrong payload.

lxml.isoschematron.Schematron rejects sbgn_pd.sch as published; building the XSLT directly with iso_svrl_for_xslt1 compiles but fires zero rules (silent no-op, gives false 'valid'). Fixed by in-memory edits and verifying 70 rules fire.
Reading JSON with the default encoding fails (cp1252) on some final_mapped.json; use utf-8.
open_questions: 96 of 188 interactions (51%) are entity-to-entity (mostly protein-protein 'binding'/'activation' with no process) and are omitted: SBGN PD modulation arcs must end at a process. Options: (a) keep omitting and count (current); (b) emit an association process glyph for binding-type relationships and a phenotype/unspecified process for the rest, which invents a process the paper did not state; (c) SBGN Entity Relationship or Activity Flow output for the interaction layer. Cost of (b)/(c): a second SBGN language or an invented process node. Product owner to decide.

Interactions with a relationship such as component_of, same_as, cofactor_of, binds are exported as generic modulation arcs (brief: otherwise modulation); some of these (component_of, SAME_AS) are not modulation semantically.

Reactions without biological_state take the compartment from the IR reaction when an IR is given, else a synthetic 'unspecified' compartment (11 of 97 files). Whether to drop those glyphs or infer a compartment from the enzyme is a product call.
